name: Einar
source:
Einar is Imre's childhood best friend. They are two peas in a pod, finishing each other's sentences (and each other's food!). Together, they're tasked with caring for a world. Him being the rational, calm and collected of the two and her being the bold and the brave. To both of them, this sounds like a sweet deal. But, is it really?

[From [url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/imres-curse-the-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
